s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent lesion of the nasal vestibule with local invasion
salient_findings: Recurrent lesion of the right nasal vestibule mucosa
Tumor within the nasal vestibule floor and ala
key_facts: Female patient in her 50s
Never-smoker
Initial lesion biopsied 5 years prior
Initial biopsy reported as solid and cystic hidradenoma
p63 positive, pancytokeratin positive, and p16 negative on initial biopsy
Lesion recurred 8 months prior to presentation
Second excision showed p63 positive and p16 negative with positive margins
Imaging showed thicker right ala compared to the left ala
Tumor extended into the floor of the nasal vestibule
Microscopic examination showed downward papillomatous proliferation of small, uniform, slightly atypical keratinocytes

differentials: Adenoid cystic carcinoma of the skin
per_call: Adenoid cystic carcinoma of the skin

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent lesion with local invasion and atypical keratinocytes

shortlist.label: Basal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Common skin cancer with potential for local invasion

shortlist.label: Hidradenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant counterpart of hidradenoma, given patient's history of hidradenoma

shortlist.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive salivary gland tumor with potential for perineural invasion

shortlist.label: Verrucous carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Low-grade malignancy with local invasion and potential for recurrence

raw.rationale: The microscopic examination showing downward papillomatous proliferation of small, uniform, slightly atypical keratinocytes is consistent with verrucous carcinoma, and the clinical presentation of a recurrent lesion with positive margins also supports this diagnosis

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: While possible, the lack of clear evidence of significant atypia or invasion in the microscopic examination makes this less likely

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The initial biopsy reported as solid and cystic hidradenoma and the microscopic examination do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Hidradenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The initial biopsy was reported as a benign hidradenoma, and the clinical course does not clearly indicate a malignant transformation

rejected.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
rejected.why: The microscopic examination does not show the characteristic cribriform or tubular patterns of adenoid cystic carcinoma
